channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Project Hospital
item.description: Become an ace doctor, an aspiring architect and a successful manager at the same time. Design your very own hospital, tweak every detail or choose one of the prebuilt scenarios and just jump to the doctor’s duty.

item.title: Snacko
item.description: Driven away by the cost of living, you and your childhood friend set off with the goal to turn things around and start a new life. Explore, gather, and build up the town from scratch into a place you'll be proud to call "home"!

item.title: Before Your Eyes
item.description: Embark on an emotional first-person narrative adventure where you control the story—and affect its outcomes—with your real-life blinks. With this innovative technique you will fully immerse yourself in a world of memories, both joyous and heartbreaking, as your whole life flashes before your eyes.

item.title: Crystal Breaker Inc
item.description: Crystal Breaker is a short incremental space game about flying, mining, and upgrading. Destroy crystal formations with your ship, unlock rare new upgrades, mine crystals and credits, and grow stronger through a skill tree.

item.title: Funi Raccoon Game
item.description: Explore a series of whimsical, interconnected worlds to steal everything not nailed down. Make a garbage bin a garbage home :)

item.title: Goodnight Universe
item.description: From the creators of Before Your Eyes — You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

item.title: Obduction
item.description: A new sci-fi adventure from Cyan, the creators of Myst. Abducted far across the universe, you find yourself on a broken alien landscape with odd pieces of Earth. Explore, uncover, solve, and find a way to make it home.

item.title: Recycling Center Simulator
item.description: Recycling Center Simulator is a business simulator game with a first person view. Make money from garbage, collect raw materials for your recycling center from different locations, recycle them, make money by producing new products and improve your factory.

item.title: Shady Knight
item.description: Shady Knight is a first-person skill-driven melee action game centered around swift swordplay, acrobatic archery, and fluid platforming that seamlessly blends combat and parkour skills into a stylish dance of death full of creative chaos.

item.title: The Walking Dead
item.description: A five-part adventure horror series set in the same universe as Robert Kirkman’s award-winning comic book series.

item.title: Tower Unite
item.description: PLAY, CREATE, PARTY! Tower Unite is a community-based virtual world party game with online games, entertainment, activities, and absolutely NO microtransactions.

item.title: Unmourned
item.description: Unmourned is a first-person psychological horror game where Jason moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal events. Driven by fear, he must uncover the truth behind the previous owners' disappearance. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

item.title: Unpossess 2: Exorcism Simulator
item.description: A 1-4 co-op exorcism simulator game set in the late 1900s. Play as exorcists responsible for addressing cases of demonic possession.

item.title: Alien Apocalypse
item.description: An open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

item.title: CICADAMATA"
item.description: + follow the white rabbit + hop, skip, and jump to become one with joyeuse, until you are no longer you +

item.title: Detective Sherlock: Shadow Stalker
item.description: Every character remembers, watches, tests, and may deceive you like a living person. They have emotions, voices, expressions, and buried secrets. Break them with words or evidence — or realize too late that you were only a pawn in their game. A detective game built around truly lifelike NPCs.

item.title: FEAR OF FAITH
item.description: FEAR OF FAITH is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where cloned soldiers raid cursed WWII bunkers. Choose your class, combine spells and drink BEER to keep your FEAR away, or face a fate worse than DEATH

item.title: Mall: Tidy Up Together
item.description: Shelve the products, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the mall. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

item.title: Minsgon Simulator
item.description: Hatch mysterious eggs and discover over 150 Minsgon species! Tame, raise and train wild creatures to make them evolve, then sell them in your shop and garden. Unlock the skill tree and rise to fame in the world of Minsgon!

item.title: Moo Who?
item.description: Can you sound like an animal well enough to survive? Moo Who is a multiplayer voice-mimicry party game where animal players hide among NPCs, and make animal sounds into their mic before hunters figure out who is fake.

item.title: Settler's Domain
item.description: Settler's Domain is a strategy game about building a new settlement in unknown lands. Grow your population, explore the map, and contend with other settlements while keeping your settlers alive.

item.title: The Sorting Bureau
item.description: A cozy sorting game set in a quiet Tokyo workshop. Clients bring you boxes of clutter: buttons, coins, gears, stamps. Sort, match, and piece everything together with satisfying ASMR clicks. No timers. Mistakes cost nothing. Just the joy of tidying up.

item.title: VHOLUME
item.description: VHOLUME is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.
